senses.en_definition: Late; occurring or arriving after the appointed, expected, or appropriate time.

messages.en: Sorry, I might be a bit late. Traffic's bad. Are you there yet?
Yeah, I'm inside the café. No worries, just text me when you get here.
Okay, I reckon I'll be there in about ten minutes. I'll text you then.
This soup's too salty. Shall we add a little water?
Sure, just add a tiny bit first. Then we'll taste it again.

senses.en_definition: To come loose, slip free, escape, or be released.
To escape or become free from something harmful or undesirable.
To miss a form of transport, an opportunity, or an event.
To say something unintentionally, or to overlook something inadvertently.

messages.en: Oh no, I missed the bus. It was just pulling away when I got there. I'll have to wait for the next one.
No worries, I'll wait at the café for now. Let me know when you're on the bus, okay?

senses.en_definition: To take part in or be connected with an activity, matter, or situation.

messages.en: Do you want to help out with our food distribution project this weekend? We're still looking for more people.
I'd love to, but I can only come in the morning. Could I help pack the food?
Absolutely! We start at eight. I'll add you to the group chat in a bit, okay?
